ruleDefinitions.name: Compress Data and Lock With Password for Exfiltration With 7-ZIP
ruleDefinitions.description: An adversary may compress or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration using 3rd party utilities

sequences.query: ((process_description = RGX(".*7\\-Zip.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\7z\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7zr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7za\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "7z\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "7za\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ a\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ u\\ .*")))
